MATCH (f:Movie {name:'The Fighter'})-[:releasedIn]->(c:Country)
MATCH (m:Movie)-[:originatesFrom]->(c)
WHERE m.global_box_office_usd IS NOT NULL
RETURN m.name AS name
ORDER BY m.global_box_office_usd DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
